description: This file defines the PayloadMappingDefinition interface, which represents a set of payload mappings within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It includes method signatures for managing payload mapping definitions, converting the object to JSON, and constructing modified copies.

classes.name: PayloadMappingDefinition
classes.description: An interface defining a collection of payload mapping definitions identified by unique IDs, with methods to retrieve, add, and check definitions, as well as convert the object into JSON representation.

methods.name: getDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the map of payload mapping definitions keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: withDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new instance with a specified mapping ID and mapping context, effectively adding or replacing a mapping definition.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether any mapping definitions are present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the payload mapping definition to a JsonObject, using the default schema version and field selector.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the payload mapping definition to a JsonObject with specific schema version and field selector, returning the subset specified by the selector.
